semantics.authorization: original session possession plus current self-user historical disclosure policy; not executable session authority
semantics.event_semantics: Original code-free email_verification_otp correlation observes the existing consuming command. Both committed and denied terminal history are successful metadata observations after current authorization. No address projection, code comparison, attempt debit, resend, mutation, session or credential delivery. Unknown remains unknown. Cookie transport requires exact Origin and the original stored-session synchronizer even after the verification invalidates executable identifier authority. Recovery applies the existing verification IP budget only, not challenge debit.

semantics.access: original authenticated-session possession and current historical disclosure policy
semantics.authorization: original session possession plus current self-user historical disclosure policy; not executable session authority
semantics.event_semantics: Original code-free primary-email change correlation observes the existing consuming command under current self-user disclosure policy and original session possession/CSRF. Committed and denied terminal history are metadata only; no address projection, code comparison/debit, primary replacement, notification, resend or credential issuance. Unknown remains unknown. Recovery applies verification IP admission only, not another challenge debit.

fields.name: TenantID
fields.semantics: Exact original tenant, agreeing with retained recovery and trusted transport host.

fields.name: UserID
fields.semantics: Original nonanonymous self user. HTTP derives it only from authenticated original session possession.

fields.name: Caller
fields.semantics: Trusted exact self-user recovery action and current disclosure policy, not original command authority.

fields.name: Flow
fields.semantics: Original actual authenticated-session token and session ID; neither renewed nor required to remain executable for history.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Exact original Send, attempt, command, fingerprint/key, expected version and scope/digest-key correlation, with no code.

fields.name: CommandID
fields.semantics: Original consuming command only; no replacement command is allocated.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.semantics: Observed original durability, independent of subsequent current-authorization or disclosure failure. Unknown is never rollback.

fields.name: Address
fields.semantics: Always zero during recovery, including committed history.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Unchanged original code-free correlation, never permission to resubmit.

fields.name: Replayed
fields.semantics: True for an original historical observation, not an executed mutation.

fields.name: RetryAfter
fields.semantics: Bounded original pending receipt delay; no automatic retry or new attempt.

variants.semantics: Malformed original recovery or mixed subject/session namespace.
Original possession or current self-user disclosure authority denies. Historical denial is an observed result, not this current authorization error.
Retained original plan/correlation mismatch; never adopt a replacement.
Bounded native storage/custody/cancellation failure; retain any observed original outcome without inferring rollback.
